description.en: Open-source website blocks and components installable directly via shadcn CLI.
description.zh: 开源的现代化网页区块库，支持通过 shadcn CLI 命令行直接注入项目。

content.en: blocks.so provides cleanly crafted, open-source landing page blocks designed to be installed seamlessly using the shadcn CLI registry protocol. Developed by Lalit, each block is responsive, dark-mode ready, and optimized for instant production usage.
content.zh: blocks.so 是一套现代且高雅的开源落地页区块库，原生支持通过 shadcn CLI 注册表命令直接将组件拉取到本地工程中。所有区块均原生适配暗色模式与响应式断点，代码纯净解耦，可快速组装高质量落地页。
